stage: independent source/target baseline before editor proposals
verdict: baseline only; no candidate or approval
observations: Source is recognizable and readable: warm golden skin, dark cropped hair, round spectacles and blue outfit. Hair crown is a broad faceted cap, its fringe separate bead forms; side hair exposes conspicuous pale scalp notches, while the back reads as a thick horizontal hair block.

Head, ears and hands retain box-like planes. Collar reads as two disconnected flat rectangles rather than constructed garment; trousers/shoes merge into very dark horizontal bands. These are useful native modeling improvement opportunities rather than required source geometry.

Target is warmer, softer and more dimensional: full layered hair, rounded glasses/head/ears, cheek warmth, formed nose/smile, soft hands and clear polo/cuff/placket/shoe construction. Exact target texture, part counts and broadened framing are not necessary. The target right-side orange highlight is not authority for directional capture lighting.
At logical192x320, pupils and glasses must stay distinct despite softened shading. The all-facing source sheet shows why back/side construction and dark apparel detail matter beyond a front match.

Actual native source has a1.25 root scale and25bone rest rig. Main480samples plus runtime96samples measured independently. Seated/eat body maxworldZ~1.74698, standing~1.27611 and happy~1.33425, so a standing absolute height cap across every action would invalidate original motion.

Main food owner is held_dish-cucumber image plane. Runtime salmon retains a renamed S10 meal held_dish-cucumber owner. Exact original image bytes are1254square packed cutouts. Only main eat/seated_wait show food (96samples); runtime eat-salmon shows48 and seated-wait-empty remains invisible48.

Canonical whole rasters can keep exactly those visible widths and true bottom-rim support with fixedfullUV/aspect mappings. Padded quad-corner identity would incorrectly change visible plate size/support.
